# beforeModel

open suspend override fun [beforeModel](before-model.html)(context: [CallbackContext](../../com.google.adk.kt.agents/-callback-context/index.html), request: [LlmRequest](../../com.google.adk.kt.models/-llm-request/index.html)): [CallbackChoice](../../com.google.adk.kt.callbacks/-callback-choice/index.html)<[LlmRequest](../../com.google.adk.kt.models/-llm-request/index.html), [LlmResponse](../../com.google.adk.kt.models/-llm-response/index.html)>

Callback executed before an LLM request is sent.

Provides an opportunity to inspect, log, or modify the [LlmRequest](../../com.google.adk.kt.models/-llm-request/index.html) object. It can also be used to implement caching by returning a cached [LlmResponse](../../com.google.adk.kt.models/-llm-response/index.html), which skips the actual model call.

#### Return

A [CallbackChoice](../../com.google.adk.kt.callbacks/-callback-choice/index.html) where returning [CallbackChoice.Break](../../com.google.adk.kt.callbacks/-callback-choice/-break/index.html) with a custom [LlmResponse](../../com.google.adk.kt.models/-llm-response/index.html) triggers an early exit, returning the response immediately and bypassing the model call. Returning [CallbackChoice.Continue](../../com.google.adk.kt.callbacks/-callback-choice/-continue/index.html) with a potentially modified [LlmRequest](../../com.google.adk.kt.models/-llm-request/index.html) propagates the request to the model normally.

#### Parameters

 _context_

The context of the current agent call.

_request_

The prepared request object to be sent to the model.
